granted.description: Whether the consumer-authorized action or section is available.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation shown to users and wired to assistive technology.

requirement.description: Named scope, permission, or policy requirement. A section gate shows it small and monospaced on its own line, as "requires <requirement>".

title.description:
Heading of a denied `'section'` gate, in the person's words, such as "Your sign-in can't
open Hooks". Ignored by the inline variant.

headingLevel.description: Heading level of the section title.

layout.description: Layout of a denied `'section'` gate. Ignored by the inline variant.

class.description: Custom class merged with the denied-state wrapper or section placeholder.

unsupportedProps.name: actions
unsupportedProps.description:
Actions rendered under a denied `'section'` gate, such as "See your scopes" or "Back to
Home". Give them the secondary button variant: a gate has no primary action.

unsupportedProps.name: children
unsupportedProps.description: Gated content. Rendered untouched when access is granted.
